# Review, iliad-141 (Iliad 22.289–404)

Two passes over `units.json` (55 units). Pass 1: notes against the Greek, Greek against `l`, `l` against `i`, every epithet and formula against the house table (`conventions.md`, `../odyssey/conventions.md`), repeated lines against the packet, cross-references against the archive. Pass 2: re-read every edited unit, then mechanical checks (`t` identical to the draft in all 55 units, JSON valid, line division of `l` equals that of `t`, quotation marks balanced and each “ matched by a `mark`, typographic ’ only). No modern translation was consulted or recalled. `gloss.json` was not opened (the glosser was writing it); its parse check is left to the glosser's reviewer pass.

Counts: 12 high, 14 medium, 7 low (33 edits to `units.json`). `new-renderings.md` was brought into line with the edits (rows for 22.302–303, 22.331, 22.336, 22.353, 22.360, 22.376, 22.397 and the mark list).

Severity: high = departs from a house-table rendering or gets the sense wrong; medium = a false note claim, label or cross-reference, a repeated line not matching its published English, or a note that shipped process talk; low = tidiness.

## Findings considered and refused

- **348 ὡς οὐκ ἔσθ’ ὃς … ἀπαλάλκοι**: kept. "As surely as there is no one who can keep the dogs from your head" reads ὡς as the asseverative ("as surely as") attached to the wish, which is the reading the syntax allows without a change to the Greek; the alternatives ("no one will", "there is no one who will save") are worse because the optative is potential. `l` "so surely is there no one who could keep…" is the word-for-word shadow of it. The note says "as surely as". Not changed.
- **336 ἀϊκῶς**: kept. The note says honestly that the adverb "seems to belong with ἀεικής"; `l`/`i` "in unseemly fashion" follows the table's ἀεικής "unseemly". The sense is not known beyond that, and the note does not claim more.
- **349 εἰκοσινήριτα**: kept. The note says the second part is not known; `l` "twenty times over" and `i` "twenty times as much" commit only to the first part. "Countless" (ἀπερείσια) was rightly avoided by the drafter.
- **354 κατὰ πάντα δάσονται**: kept. "Share you out in every part" / "divide you up, every part of you" gives the verb as δαίομαι "divide" (not "devour") and κατὰ πάντα as "in every part", which is a fair reading and the note says it. The other reading ("entirely") would give the same picture, the whole body shared out.
- **304 ἀσπουδί departing from the table**: accepted. The table row itself says "the sense follows the context and the note says so", and the note does say so. "Without a fight" is not among the words the row turns down ("a struggle", "unhurried", "unscathed"). Only the note's report of the table ("without effort") was wrong, and is fixed.
- **360 `i` "good warrior that you are"**: kept. "Good" is the table word; "warrior" is not a rendering of ἐσθλός but the noun that English needs for the masculine participle, and the note says what the word means of a man in battle. "Good man" would read as moral.
- **319 `i` "most easily" for μάλιστα**: kept; "where it would give way most easily" is an idiomatic form of "most", and `l` has "most".
- **378 `l` "granted us to subdue"**: kept. The infinitive needs its subject in English and "us" is the only one the speech allows.
- **Unit 0 not citing 3.355** for the first line: not an error (the note need not cite it); the English matches the published unit at iliad-019.
- **Table-conforming and checked, no change**: λευκάσπιδα (no table row; the new rendering is consistent with λευκός and ἀσπίς), μακρὸν ἀΰσας "shouting loudly" (6.66), ἑκηβόλῳ "far-shooting", ἐφάμην "I thought" (3.366), ἐσσομένοισι "yet to come" (Od. 11.76), νυκτὸς ἀμολγῷ "dead of night" / "depths of the night" (11.173), ἐρεβεννῶν "murky", μείλινον "ashen", τετραφάλῳ "four-ridged", δαιδάλεον "cunningly wrought", χρόα καλόν "fair skin", ἐπεύξατο "cried out in triumph" (13.373), πόδας ὠκύς and ποδάρκης, κορυθαίολος, ὑπόδρα formula (4.411 pattern), ἄστυ "town", κοῦροι Ἀχαιῶν, ἄκλαυτος ἄθαπτος (Od. 11.54), μήνιμα, σιδήρεος, λελάχωσι, ἄποινα "ransom", ἀεικέα "unseemly", πότμον "doom", κηλέῳ "blazing", νέκυς "dead man", πότνια μήτηρ "lady mother", Σκαιαὶ πύλαι, φρένες "wits" / "mind", γοόωσα (published English kept), ἔθειραι χρύσεαι.
- **Repeated lines checked against the packet**: 289 (iliad-019), 292, 308 (fixed), 316, 327, 337, 342–343, 361–363, 366, 372, 378, 385. Whole-unit matches (337, 361, 362–363, 385) are identical in `l` and `i`; the rest take the published wording as far as the sentence allows.
- **Quotation marks and marks**: eight speeches (297, 331, 338, 345, 356, 365, 373, 378); “ on the first unit of each with a `mark`, ” on the last unit (305, 336, 343, 354, 360, 366, 374, 394); eight “ and eight ” in `l`, none in the middle units; the part opens after a speech that closed in iliad-140 (288) and closes outside one. `p` is on exactly the nine ¶ units (289, 306, 337, 344, 355, 361, 367, 375, 395).

## Gloss pass

Second pass over `gloss.json` (102 novel entries, 25 `__broaden__` entries) against the Greek of `units.json`. All 25 broadened entries begin with the published entry whole + ' · '; no novel key is already published; no novel entry has a straight apostrophe, a line number, "here" or 230+ characters. Checked and kept: τέτρηνε→ἔτρησε, ἔρρεξεν→ἔδρασεν, λελείμμην→ἐλελείμμην (plpf. mid./pass. 1 sg., correct), ἀλέη 'escape' (Il. 22.301 sense), εἰκοσινήριτ’ (flagged uncertain in the entry), προτιόσσομαι (flagged).

| form | what was wrong | fix |
|---|---|---|
| δάσονται | rendering "among them, tear" had no basis in the form (δατέομαι, fut. 3 pl.) | `’will share out among them, tear’` → `’will share out, divide up’` |
| ἀγητὸν | "wondrous" is turned down by the table for ἀγητός; unit renders "admirable" | `wondrous, admirable` → `admirable` |
| ἀϊκῶς | gloss "shamefully" departs from the table word ἀεικής "unseemly" | `unseemly, shameful` → `unseemly, disgraceful` |
| ἀϊκῶς | same | `’shamefully’` → `’in unseemly fashion’` |
| ἱμάντας | table: ἱμάς "straps", "thongs" turned down | `strap, thong` → `strap` |
| βοέους | spelling against the table/Odyssey "oxhide" | `of ox-hide; adj` → `of oxhide; adj` |
| βοέους | same | `’of ox-hide’` → `’of oxhide’` |
| τετραφάλῳ | "four-plumed" conflicts with the unit rendering "four-ridged" | `four-plumed (sense traditional)` → `with four ridges (φάλοι) or crest-holders (sense traditional)` |
| ἀνουτητί | "without a wound" is ambiguous (reads as unwounded); sense is without a thrust being given | `without a wound (` → `without a wound dealt (` |
| ἐξεναρίζων | ἐξεναρίζω is "slay and strip" (published ἐξενάριξε "killed and stripped"); rendering dropped the first half | `’while stripping’` → `’while killing and stripping’` |
| αὐτόν | με is the object; "that I myself" made it a subject | `(αὐτόν με … ’that I myself …’)` → `(αὐτόν με … ’me myself …’)` |
